openai.feedback:
- Category: bug
- Severity: medium
- File: `shared/scripts/lib/adr_index.py:108-115`
- Finding: Fenced-code detection does not preserve fence length. `_FENCE_RE` captures only the first three backticks/tilde characters, so an opening four-backtick fence (````) is treated as a three-backtick fence and incorrectly closed by a later ``` line. A subsequent `# heading` that is still inside the actual fenced block can then be selected as the ADR title, violating the requirement that titles be outside fenced code blocks.
- Suggestion: Capture the complete opening fence run (for example, `` `{3,}` `` / `~{3,}`) and only close when the same fence character has a run at least as long as the opening fence. Add coverage for a four-or-more-character opening fence with a shorter apparent closing fence and an H1 inside the still-open block.

Overall assessment: the implementation covers the producers, rendering behavior, drift guard, compatibility re-export, and commit staging path well, but the Markdown fence parser has a concrete title-extraction correctness hole. Ship with the fence-handling fix and corresponding test.
